# Hiyd

> Hiyd is the Jekyll Companion App — a suite of apps and extensions that help you generate markdown content for your Jekyll site.
Create posts with front matter quickly on iOS, and capture content for link posts in Chromium browsers.

Hiyd is made in the UK by thechels.uk. Key features include quick markdown generation; create, save, edit, and export workflows;
custom front matter defaults; privacy via iCloud file storage; quick previews; biometric locking; iPhone and iPad support;
and Shortcuts & Siri integration. Version 2.0 also includes direct to GitHub publishing using personal access tokens.

## Apps & Extensions

- [Hiyd on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hiyd/id6746853559): iOS app for creating Jekyll posts with front matter on iPhone and iPad.
- [Hiyd on the Chrome Web Store](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/hiyd/hkeklhoojnogpfmiikadpcmkmpldhpce): Chromium browser extension for capturing content for link posts.
